question: What is the total scope of agitation caused by this practice, O Goddess?
premises: The practice affects beings in all realms.
The three worlds include moving and still beings.
The agitation encompasses all of them.
inference: Therefore, O Goddess, it agitates the three worlds with all their moving and still beings.
plain_english: O Goddess, it agitates the three worlds with all their moving and still beings.
